summary: Frontend mobile flow tested on the public Expo preview. Dashboard empty state, add navigation, blank amount validation, valid $24.50 save, persistence after reload, summary cards, doughnut breakdown, seven-day trend, and category filter all passed. Edit/delete could not be completed in the final continuation because the web preview did not expose the expected row action selector after filter reset; this appears to be test-state/selector behavior, not a confirmed product failure.
action_items: Re-run edit and delete with a fresh isolated browser context and horizontal chip scrolling before release sign-off.
critical_code_review_comments: No API is used; local storage persistence is implemented with awaited writes. Expo logs only report non-blocking package compatibility warnings.

success_rate.frontend: 80% of executed checks passed; edit/delete require retest

seed_data_creation: Created one local test expense ($24.50, Food, Lunch) during browser testing; browser storage was cleared before the primary run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public preview: https://expense-tracker-6729.preview.emergentagent.com. Use a fresh context, clear storage, add one expense, navigate History, scroll the horizontal category chip strip, then reset All and verify edit/delete row actions.
rca_of_issue: The first run's chart assertion was a test sequencing error because save intentionally navigates to Transactions. The corrected run passed charts after navigating Home. A later continuation showed Transportation filtering correctly, but after selecting All the expected edit testID was absent in the rendered state; investigate with fresh context and explicit horizontal chip scrolling before classifying as an app bug. No mocked APIs were used.
